name: Backups
author: Misty
overview: Backups creates encrypted, verifiable Restic snapshots in a local folder you choose. Credentials stay in the OS vault.
capabilities: Create and verify manual snapshots with cancellation
Browse snapshots and restore into a new collision-safe local folder
permissions: Read access to chosen local source folders
Write access to the chosen repository and restore destination
getting_started: Choose an empty writable folder for the repository.
Initialize the encrypted repository after reviewing the destination.
Select local source folders and choose Back up now.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Moved backup work behind explicit folder and backup grants with Host-owned repository, credential, and restricted-process handling on macOS.
v0.3.0 - Initial production release with manual backup, verification, snapshot browsing, safe restore, and credential-vault storage.
